subject: Game Theory
title: Auction Design Principles
description: A 60-second lesson on Auction Design Principles.

hook.text: Designing an auction is designing a game. The rules you set determine how players behave.

buildup.text: Good design attracts bidders, encourages truthful bidding, and maximizes the seller's objective.

discovery.text: Key levers: open vs sealed bids, ascending vs descending, payment rules, reserve prices, and timing.

twist.text: Each lever changes incentives. Open bids reduce the winner's curse. Sealed bids prevent collusion.

climax.text: The 2020 Nobel Prize went to Milgrom and Wilson for improving auction design for public goods.

punchline.text: Design the rules, shape the outcome.

quiz.question: Who won the 2020 Nobel for auction design?
